question: Does the complete square-nut envelope stay over the flat washer face when the washer shifts within its bore?
criterion: Full outer footprint containment requires radius margin >=0. This is geometric, not a strength or allowable-pressure criterion.
assumptions: Nut square envelope uses maximum across-flats 4 mm; actual corner and face chamfers unknown.
Nut coaxial with a nominal 2 mm screw; nut/thread radial play omitted.
Washer may shift to one side of its maximum bore clearance, along a nut corner direction.
Flat bearing edge uses specified maximum radial edge break.
stop: One limiting-dimension calculation; no FE and no strength verdict.
